pass_a_gloss: Concerning posture and place and times of prayer, and facing east, and four kinds of prayer in Scripture. Closing word to Ambrose and Tatiana. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: Last come posture, place, and times of prayer — including facing east — and the [[four kinds of prayer >> Bible:1 Timothy 2:1]] named in Scripture. This closes the word to Ambrose and Tatiana. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
